resumeText: I am a QA Engineer at Danube Analytics where I own functional and regression testing for our analytics dashboard. My background is as a QA generalist: I design detailed test cases, run manual and exploratory testing, and validate API behavior with Postman. I have begun using Selenium to script simple browser checks, but my automation is not yet at framework level and I have not wired tests into CI/CD. I track everything in Jira and TestRail and use SQL to verify data correctness in test scenarios.
